landing.demoLetterTitle: Two Years After the Leap: Remembering Why I Started
landing.demoLetterContent:
If you are reading this, two years have elapsed since the afternoon you decided to change course. You were terrified of leaving stability, wondering if you had the courage to build something of your own.

I hope you learned to worry less about timelines and more about being present. Don't forget that you promised to cherish the small rituals: unhurried morning coffee, adopting that dog once you had a terrace, and making time for those you love.

Be proud of where you are. We worked hard to bring you here.
landing.demoArticleContent:
If you are reading this, two years have elapsed since the afternoon you decided to change course. You were terrified of leaving stability, wondering if you had the courage to build something of your own.

I hope you learned to worry less about timelines and more about being present. Don't forget that you promised to cherish the small rituals: unhurried morning coffee, adopting that dog once you had a terrace, and making time for those you love.

Be proud of where you are. We worked hard to bring you here.

about.title: A private place to write to your future self.
about.subtitle: TimeEcho is a digital time capsule. Write private letters, record how you feel, make predictions, and open them years later to see what changed.

what_is.title: Why write to your future self?
what_is.description: It's easy to forget what you cared about and what you expected. TimeEcho lets you write that down and keep it locked until a date you choose.

how_works.title: How TimeEcho Works
how_works.step_write_desc: Write a private letter, rate how you feel, and add predictions about your future.
how_works.step_seal_desc: Choose a delivery date and timezone. Your letter is encrypted and locked until then.
how_works.step_wait_desc: Go on with your life. Your letter stays safe until the date.
how_works.step_receive_desc: On the date, the letter arrives in your inbox. Read it and check your predictions.

why_exists.title: Built for honest writing
why_exists.description: There are no public feeds, likes, or ads. It's a quiet place to write to yourself.

philosophy.title: Privacy
philosophy.description: Your letters are yours. We don't sell data, use advertising cookies, or analyze your letters. If you delete your account, your data is permanently removed.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Security Promise
privacy.subtitle: Your letters are private. We encrypt your content, never sell your data, and show no ads.

intro.title: How we handle your privacy
intro.description: TimeEcho ("we", "us", or "our") exists to protect your personal evolution and private thoughts. This Privacy Policy outlines how we safeguard your information, handle data encryption, and ensure your time capsules remain private.

collect.title: What Information We Collect
collect.description: We collect only what is essential to store and deliver your time capsules securely:
collect.item_email: Your email address (used strictly for passwordless magic-link sign-ins and letter delivery)
collect.item_letters: Encrypted letter content and titles (protected with zero-knowledge encryption at rest)
collect.item_predictions: Future predictions and retrospective reflections you choose to write
collect.item_emotional: Emotional snapshot ratings (happiness, anxiety, and motivation levels)
collect.item_preferences: Interface settings (color theme, language, and notification choices)
collect.item_technical: Essential technical logs necessary for account security and service performance

how_use.title: How We Use Your Information
how_use.description: We use your data solely to fulfill your time capsule experience:
how_use.item_accounts: Authenticate your account via single-use magic links
how_use.item_store: Safely store your encrypted letters until your chosen delivery date
how_use.item_deliver: Send your unsealed capsules to your verified email address on schedule
how_use.item_communicate: Send critical account confirmations and delivery notifications
how_use.item_improve: Maintain security, optimize page load speed, and enhance reliability
how_use.item_security: Block automated abuse, prevent spam, and protect user data

encryption.title: End-to-End Privacy & Encryption
encryption.description: Letter titles and personal thoughts are encrypted before being stored. Nobody—not even our team—can read your words while your letter remains sealed in the vault.

retention.title: Data Retention & Instant Deletion
retention.description: We retain your time capsules for as long as your account remains active. If you choose to delete your account in Settings, all associated letters, emotional snapshots, predictions, and analytics events are permanently and irreversibly purged from our database.

third_parties.title: Trusted Infrastructure Partners
third_parties.description: We work with trusted industry providers to process and deliver your capsules:
third_parties.item_email: Resend API for transactional email delivery
third_parties.item_hosting: Hardened cloud infrastructure with isolated, encrypted databases

rights.title: Your Data Rights & Control
rights.description: You retain total ownership of your words. You have the right to:
rights.item_access: Inspect and export your letter timeline at any time
rights.item_delete: Delete individual letters or purge your entire account in one click
rights.item_questions: Reach out to our team with privacy or technical data inquiries

changes.title: Policy Updates
changes.description: If we make material updates to this Privacy Policy, we will post the changes here and notify active users via email.

delivery.description: TimeEcho processes scheduled capsules daily and sends them on or near your requested local unlock date using transactional mailers.

availability.title: Service Availability
availability.description: We strive for 99.9% uptime, but access may occasionally be interrupted for scheduled maintenance, system updates, or emergency server repairs.

termination.title: Account Cancellation
termination.description: You may delete your account at any time via Settings. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these prohibited conduct rules.
